info.name: Buddha Berry
info.description: Contains-25.4g Protein. A zen-like infusion of antioxidants and strength. 100g robusta banana blended with a triple-berry medley of blueberry, strawberry, and raspberry compotes and 25g Yoga Bar Pea Protein. Elevated with creamy soy milk and topped with 50g of Rich’s whip cream. Finished with a frozen berry garnish for a vibrant, forest-fruit flavor and a smooth, balanced recovery.

info.name: Moonwalk Matcha
info.description: Contains-21.1g Protein. A silky, high-performance blend of premium vanilla-infused matcha and pure honey. Cold-blended with a 100g rich vanilla bean cream base and 20g of Yoga Bar Whey for a thick, out-of-this-world texture. Clean, revitalizing energy for a smooth recovery—designed to lift your performance without the crash.

info.name: Monster's Own
info.description: Contains-21.2g Protein. Our darkest, most powerful creation. A high-octane blend of double espresso, 50g of decadent 55% dark chocolate ganache, and Mystiva cocoa. Fortified with 20g of Yoga Bar Whey and swirled with a rich frozen vanilla velvet for a smooth, chilled finish. Intense, bittersweet, and unapologetically thick. Not for the faint of heart—this is fuel for the inner beast.

info.name: Caribbean Jack
info.description: Contains-21.6g Protein. A tropical escape in every sip. 120g of pure Alphonso mango and 25g of Yoga Bar Pea Protein blended with a creamy fusion of coconut and oat milk. Touched with a hint of tender coconut syrup and finished with 100g of Rich's whip cream for a rich, velvety sunshine-yellow glow. Smooth, exotic, and built for a refreshing recovery.

info.name: Iron Monk
info.description: Contains - 37g protein. A disciplined force in a glass. 100g robusta banana and 52g chocolate crunchy peanut butter blended with 40g dessert king dates and 25g Yoga Bar Pea Protein, finished with chilled almond milk and ice. Ultra-thick, dairy-free, and built for clean strength. Focused fuel for the relentless grind.

info.name: Chocolate Chaos
info.description: Contains-21.2g Protein. A high-intensity, dark chocolate eruption. An explosive fusion of 30g of 55% dark ganache, Mystiva cocoa, and rich chocolate sauce, reinforced with 20g of Yoga Bar Whey and a 100g vanilla bean cream base. Thick, dark, and beautifully chaotic. The ultimate recovery for the chocolate obsessed—engineered to satisfy your deepest cravings while fueling your grind.

info.name: Italia Espresso Pro
info.description: Contains-21.8g Protein. A sophisticated, high-performance tribute to the Italian classic. A bold double shot of espresso blended with a 100g premium vanilla bean cream base and 20g of Yoga Bar Whey. Silky, caffeinated, and perfectly balanced. The pro-athlete’s affogato—built for those who demand intensity and elegance in one glass.

info.name: Kaapi Pro
info.description: Contains-21.3g Protein. A soulful, high-performance tribute to the South Indian classic. A bold 25g hit of slow-dripped filter coffee decoction blended with a 100g premium vanilla bean cream base and 20g of Yoga Bar Whey. Earthy, nostalgic, and perfectly balanced. The local hero’s recovery—heritage flavor meets modern metabolic strength
